projects.title: Phishing Website Detection AI
projects.description: AI-based system designed to detect phishing websites using machine learning. The project analyzes URL and website features to classify malicious and legitimate sites, helping reduce phishing risks. Built with a focus on accuracy, performance, and real-world cybersecurity application.

projects.title: AI Cybersecurity Threat Detection System
projects.description: An AI-powered cybersecurity threat detection system that identifies and mitigates potential cyber threats in real-time. The system leverages machine learning algorithms to analyze network traffic and detect anomalies, providing enhanced security for organizations.
